Daily advice for busy families
Someone on the desk wanted you to know
Travelers: check your pet papers before you arrive and keep carriers secure for smooth handoff at Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk notice

Our ground team moves carriers carefully between services, and staff record each change in the desk ledger. <<FACT F060>> Bring only the approved carrier, with clean bedding and clear labels, so the acceptance check stays brisk. 

For larger dogs, carrier fit must be confirmed before check-in. <<FACT F069>> Keep water available, follow crew directions, and allow extra room at the desk for any last review.

If your plans change, tell the Companion Animal Travel Desk at once so we can adjust the record and keep the journey orderly. Companion Animal Travel Desk
